component.name: Clean USB
component.summary: Wipe, format, and benchmark USB drives for Windows

description.p: Clean USB detects connected USB drives and prepares them for use with Windows. Drives are formatted as exFAT with a GPT partition table — compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux with no file size limits.

ul.li: Quick wipe — clears partition tables and signatures
Secure wipe — full zero pass, data unrecoverable
Speed benchmark — sustained read and write throughput

description.p: Only targets USB devices. Refuses to touch system drives. Privilege escalation handled via PolicyKit — the app runs as your user.
